title: Manifest world_interaction board v1 + world intent_kinds entry
description: How to use this document: (1) validate manifest.world_interaction against the ROOT schema here; (2) when world_interaction is present, validate every manifest.intent_kinds[] entry against #/$defs/intent_kind_entry; (3) validate every event_kinds[] row whose transport is 'house' against #/$defs/event_kind_entry (typed rows keep the legacy shape untouched). Everything else in the house manifest (house, official_ids, core_primitives, the G0-owned house_session board) keeps its existing vocabulary; this contract only adds the board and the two entry extensions. Manifest proof transport: the served manifest body bytes ARE the digest basis (capability_revision); the detached ManifestProof travels in the response header 'X-Popclaw-Manifest-Proof' as base64 of the proto bytes — the body is never wrapped or altered, keeping ADR-0048-era byte semantics intact. Endpoint rules: the control endpoints are FIXED same-origin relative paths (const values). A client resolving them MUST reject protocol-relative URLs, backslashes, query strings, and any cross-origin or ambiguous-path form (G0 600f0273 endpoint hardening precedent), and MUST reject cross-origin redirects at HTTP time. Board version 2 or higher from a newer contract: old clients disable world features for that house only (never unrelated houses) and continue without them. Activation-time steps that this JSON layer cannot express and that reject the capability rather than being skipped: every params_schema/result_schema/body_schema is meta-validated against schema-profile.schema.json; handler registration binds (kind, schema_version, capability_revision, worker_id) and an absent handler must not be advertised as executable.

closure_status.$comment: Non-public restricted exit-control endpoint (ClosureQueryRequest/Response). Houses declaring execution_closure MUST serve it; the value is a fixed same-origin path.

execution_closure.$comment: Opt-in stronger G3 capability. Advertising it asserts every new Intent admission path already enforces the permit/closure protocol of world_interaction.proto §6-§7. Houses without it keep G0 semantics; clients report remote=unsupported, never conflate with temporary unavailability.

result_authority_pubkey.$comment: Base58 Ed25519 public key of the pinned house result authority; signs every ActionResult over domain POPCLAW_WORLD_ACTION_RESULT_V1. Separate from the G0 session authority (manifest.house_session.ack_pubkey, G0-owned), which signs closure observations.

items.$comment: Public, anonymous-subscribable scope labels listed by the manifest. Actor-bound scopes are added later only through authenticated SubscriptionDescriptor; selection labels, never secrets.

sha256.$comment: Digest of the exact guide bytes this manifest revision is written for. The client hash-checks fetched guide bytes against this value before activating the matching capability context — a new schema can never be silently combined with old guide text. ETag remains a cache aid only.

revision.$comment: Opaque house guide revision label, for humans and logs.

schema_version.$comment: The ONE declared params/result schema version of this kind. IntentContext.schema_version must equal it; requests naming anything else get SCHEMA_VERSION_UNSUPPORTED. A kind may evolve only by shipping a new manifest revision with a higher schema_version (additive within the schema itself per ADR-0003).

purpose.$comment: Descriptive routing hint only — NEVER authorization. A snapshot-purpose handler must register read-only for world state; join-purpose marks the entry action. Absent = ordinary action.

event_kind_entry.$comment: Additive seam for manifest.event_kinds[] rows of a world-capable house (parent review item 2): existing typed rows (transport 'typed' with a proto name) keep their legacy shape unchanged; rows for HouseEvent-vocabulary events gain exactly these fields. Downlink body schemas use the same pinned profile as params.

schema_version.$comment: HouseEvent.schema_version the row declares; downlink readers validate bodies against body_schema at this version.

public_scope_declaration.$comment: manifest_scopes_only: events of this kind may only carry public_scopes listed in initial_public_scopes. dynamic_registered_scopes: the configured worker may additionally idempotently register new scopes through the internal registration call; admission still rejects unregistered scopes before fact acceptance.

profile_schema.$comment: Placeholder node: the actual value must be a JSON Schema document that itself meta-validates against schema-profile.schema.json (checked at activation; out of scope for structural JSON Schema recursion). Size-bounded by the protocol limits table (32 KiB per schema).
